# BAC STORY

> BAC STORY (بك ستوري) is Algeria's leading free educational platform dedicated to helping students prepare for the Algerian Baccalaureate exam (البكالوريا الجزائرية). The platform serves over 15,000 daily visitors across all 58 wilayas of Algeria and has a Telegram community of 16,000+ subscribers.

BAC STORY provides comprehensive, free, and accessible study materials for all six Baccalaureate streams:
1. Mathematics (شعبة رياضيات)
2. Experimental Sciences (شعبة علوم تجريبية)
3. Technical Mathematics (شعبة تقني رياضي — Technical Mathematics, encompassing Civil, Electrical, Mechanical, and Process Engineering)
4. Management & Economics (شعبة تسيير واقتصاد)
5. Literature & Philosophy (شعبة آداب وفلسفة)
6. Foreign Languages (شعبة لغات أجنبية)

The platform is founded and operated by Redouane Mohamed Islem and is accessible at https://www.bac-story.com. Contact: contact@bac-story.com

## About & Platform

- [عن المنصة](https://www.bac-story.com/about): Information about BAC STORY, its mission, educational philosophy, and team.
- [تواصل معنا](https://www.bac-story.com/contact): Direct contact channels for support, academic partnerships, or inquiries.
- [أعلن معنا](https://www.bac-story.com/advertise): Partnership and sponsorship opportunities for educators, academies, and training centers.
- [قيّم الموقع](https://www.bac-story.com/feedback): Verified student feedback, reviews, and community ratings.
- [ساهم في الموقع](https://www.bac-story.com/contribute): Open student contribution portal — submit verified summaries, exercises, booklets, or Google Drive repositories to benefit over 15,000 daily students. No account required.

## 2027 Baccalaureate Reform (إصلاحات وتغييرات منهاج بكالوريا 2027)

- [التغييرات والإصلاحات الرسمية لبكالوريا 2027](https://www.bac-story.com/bac-2027-curriculum-changes): Comprehensive guide to the official Ministry of National Education curriculum reforms, updated subject coefficients, structural hour allocations, and stream renaming for Baccalaureate 2027 candidates.
- Official Stream Information: The stream "شعبة تقني رياضي" (Technical Mathematics) encompasses Civil, Electrical, Mechanical, and Process Engineering.

## Interactive Tools (الأدوات الذكية)

- [حاسبة معدل البكالوريا](https://www.bac-story.com/tools/calculator): Free interactive Baccalaureate grade calculator with official ministerial coefficients for all six streams.
- [حاسبة المعدل الموزون](https://www.bac-story.com/tools/weighted-calc): Real-time weighted average calculator for Algerian university admissions, calculating composite scores for medicine, dentistry, pharmacy, national higher schools, and polytechnics.
- [حاسبة المعدل الموزون لتخصص الترجمة](https://www.bac-story.com/tools/weighted-calc/translation): Specialized weighted average calculator for Algerian university translation programs (تخصص الترجمة — لغات أجنبية).
- [الوقت المتبقي للبكالوريا](https://www.bac-story.com/tools/countdown): Live countdown timer to the upcoming Algerian Baccalaureate examinations and university orientation deadlines.
- [ورقة الإجابة الرسمية للبكالوريا](https://www.bac-story.com/tools/exam-sheet): Printable templates and visual training guides for the official Algerian Baccalaureate exam answer sheets (ورقة التنظيم، الورقة الخضراء، الورقة الفصلية).
- [كيفية تنظيم ورقة الإجابة](https://www.bac-story.com/tools/exam-sheet/exam-sheet-organization): Practical guide on margin management, color coding, question numbering, and presentation standards for exam day.

## Exclusive Study Series & Teacher Magazines

- [مجلات الأستاذ مرنيز في الرياضيات](https://www.bac-story.com/resources/math/math/merniz): Renowned unit-by-unit mathematics booklets for Mathematics, Sciences, and Engineering (Exponential, Logarithmic, Primitive Functions, Sequences, Probability, Complex Numbers, Arithmetics).
- [مجلات الأستاذ الخليل في الرياضيات](https://www.bac-story.com/resources/math/math/elkhalil): Comprehensive mathematics problem sets and graphical discussion guides.

## Past Papers & Exam Hub (بوابة المواضيع والامتحانات)

- [البوابة الرئيسية للمواضيع](https://www.bac-story.com/topics): Central directory for official past papers, mock exams, cadet school tests, and excellence topics.
- [مواضيع وحوليات البكالوريا الرسمية](https://www.bac-story.com/topics/bac-topics): Official Algerian Baccalaureate exam papers with model answers (2008–2026).
- [مواضيع أشبال الأمة](https://www.bac-story.com/topics/achbal-eloma): National Cadet Schools (Ecoles des Cadets de la Nation) official mock examinations with detailed grading keys.
- [مواضيع التميز](https://www.bac-story.com/topics/excellence-topics): Advanced challenge problem sets for students targeting grades above 16/20.
- [محاكاة امتحان البكالوريا](https://www.bac-story.com/simulation): Interactive browser exam simulator featuring timed sessions, PDF papers, and instant model answers.
- [أرشيف البكالوريا والحوليات المجمعة](https://www.bac-story.com/topics/bac-archives): Multi-year compiled subject annals.
- [حلول بكالوريا 2026](https://www.bac-story.com/bac-2026): Official solutions and grading rubrics for the 2026 Baccalaureate session.

## Study Plans & Excellence Challenges (الخطط والتحديات)

- [بوابة الخطط والتحديات](https://www.bac-story.com/plans): Systematic revision programs and schedules.
- [الخطط الشهرية](https://www.bac-story.com/plans/monthly): Full academic year monthly study roadmaps (September through April).
- [خطط التميز في المواد](https://www.bac-story.com/plans/subject-plans): Subject-specific methodology blueprints (Arabic, Islamic Studies, History & Geography, Languages).
- [تحديات التميز](https://www.bac-story.com/plans/challenges): Intensive short-term memorization and exercise challenges.

## University Orientation & Post-Bac Guide (التوجيه الجامعي ودليل الجامعة)

- [دليل الجامعة الشامل](https://www.bac-story.com/university): Complete guide to Algerian universities, faculties, and national institutes.
- [معدلات القبول السابقة](https://www.bac-story.com/university/averages-of-acceptance): Historical cutoff admission grades for medical sciences, national polytechnics, higher teacher training colleges (ENS), and prestigious schools.
- [الدليل الوزاري للتخصصات](https://www.bac-story.com/university/ministry-guide): Official Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research curriculum guide.
- [التعريف بالتخصصات الجامعية](https://www.bac-story.com/university/specialities): In-depth profiles of university majors, career prospects, and admission criteria.
- [دليل التجنيد العسكري](https://www.bac-story.com/university/military-guide): Guide to post-baccalaureate admission in Algerian military academies (MDN).
- [التوجيه الجامعي عبر PROGRES](https://www.bac-story.com/orientation): Step-by-step walkthrough for filling university wish lists on orientation-esi.dz.
